scope: Actual route-only and combined captured histories are prerequisites. Both arms keep graph ON; only GDN switches. Rechecks864 wire requests and ownership/resources/restoration; no unseen-schedule full-state proof, formal graph-hit observations or general quality claim.

restoration.scope: Independent retained physical/log/HTTP-worker and direct-server ps/port evidence; owner absence is a pinned-controller receipt. No numerical/performance qualification or live observation.

service_restore.scope: Raw physical/log checks independent; final HTTP status and PID/job/listener observations exist only as pinned-controller receipts.

owner_reap.scope: Phase intents/releases and retained child ps/port bytes checked; owner absence at restoration is a pinned-controller receipt.

restoration.adapter_scope: Unmodified frozen raw audit plus current-cycle original/replacement inequality; historical74384 exclusion retained. No global patch, source-path spoof or evidence rewriting.

pins.model_scope: Manifest plus source-pinned full-hash receipts before/after and unchanged current stat; not an independent payload rehash.

tokenizer_reference.scope: Actual tokenizer payload SHA plus original target stat receipts; no model shard rehash or historical link-target spelling claim.

resources.scope: Original raw pressure/AC/thermal/sustained-swap gates; retained process inventory cannot exclude unknown runtimes or GUI GPU activity.

comparisons.scope: Adjacent process comparisons with the same fixtures, not identical realized arrival schedules; no pooled-token ratio or confidence-interval claim.

absence_scope: Outer native System.read retained3fields, no stderr claim. Inner4field empty stderr is a separate earlier observation, not fabricated outer stderr.
